status: 教学包冻结设计，非外部预注册
data_origin: Original procedural synthetic images and features

protocol.gallery: 216 images / 216 paired captions; same 18 classes; stable index tie break
protocol.temperature_ablation: seed11 only, exploratory diagnostic, not used to choose primary tau

primary_question: Do one-way and symmetric dual encoders differ, and how do semantic duplicates change retrieval interpretation?
selection_rule: All specified variants and seeds retained; no early stopping or test-set model selection.
stopping_rule: Run the fixed update budget, then evaluate all declared conditions.
limitations: Synthetic finite task; no real-world generalization claim
Three training seeds share the same dataset
No pretrained model or external service
